name: receipt-printer
title: Receipt printer
description: A small checkout terminal: pay, wait for the card, then the receipt rolls out of the slot.

props.name: merchant
props.description: The shop name, shown on the terminal and at the top of the receipt.

props.name: lines
props.description: The items on the receipt, each with a label and an amount; the total is their sum.

props.name: onPay
props.description: Called when the pay button is pressed. The receipt prints once it resolves; if it throws, the button comes back.

props.name: currency
props.description: The ISO currency code used to format money. Default “EUR”.

props.name: locale
props.description: The language used to format money and the date. Default “en-IE”.

props.name: labels
props.description: Visible text and screen reader text with English defaults, for the pay button, the three statuses, the total, the new order button and the reference.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper around the terminal and the receipt.

a11y.text: The Pay button starts the run; at the end a New order button appears.

A hidden status region that stays in the page reads "Processing payment", "Printing your receipt" and "Paid". It holds only the text; the buttons sit outside it. The visible status text is aria-hidden so it is not read twice. The receipt is a list of lines. Icons and the barcode are aria-hidden.
The spinner and the button press scale stop under reduced motion, and the receipt slide uses Motion with reduced motion set to user.
